topics.headline: Eurozone HICP already decelerating; US CPI joint-acceleration bet looks shaky
topics.summary: Eurostat's flash estimate shows June HICP falling to 2.8% from 3.2%, breaking the "both higher" condition outright, while the Cleveland Fed nowcasts US CPI slowing to 3.96% from 4.2% — together making a simultaneous acceleration in both readings unlikely.

topics.headline: HY spreads near 2.7%, historically tight; no fresh deal-flow signal
topics.summary: HY OAS sits around 2.74-2.75%, a level reached only ~5% of the time since 2000, so mean-reversion risk favors widening over further tightening; beyond official spread and rates data, no meaningful deal-flow, expert, or sentiment signals were found to sharpen the 30-day call.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF flows whipsaw as $221M inflow flips to $520M outflow
topics.summary: A single-day $221.7M inflow ended a brutal 10-day, $2.73B outflow streak, but selling resumed the very next session with over $520M in outflows, leaving analysts calling it a cautious re-entry rather than a trend reversal. With YTD outflows still at $5.4B and weekly outflow pace only easing from ~$2B to $700M, sustained net inflows over the next week remain uncertain and highly momentum-dependent.

topics.headline: VIX sits below its own trailing average, tilting odds lower
topics.summary: Spot VIX (~15.6-16.4) is running well under the trailing one-month average (~18.06), so it would need a notable spike just to reach that bar in 30 days; historically VIX also tends to overstate future volatility and mean-revert, though practitioners warn the current low-vol complacency could snap into a shock given past swings between sub-11 and 30+ this year.
